title: Mandelstamm – Mischne Tora: German texts from Safran and Sefaria
description: 39 German Mandelstamm parts of Mishneh Torah, 462 chapters and 6,296 nonempty halakhot. Safran has priority at every overlapping title; all 12 German Sefaria versions are separately archived for comparison. Includes 23 documented Kings and Wars corrections, a source-checked missing negation, original metadata, source URLs, portrait, SHA-256 provenance and reproducible validation. Source-specific license fields are retained, including unknown for Sanhedrin; CC BY 4.0 applies to new editorial preparation/documentation, MIT to scripts.
